Summary: The image of God is the dignity and calling stamped on every human being: to represent God, to steward creation, and to live in relationship with Him and one another. Sin has marred but not erased the image, and Christ, the perfect image, restores it in believers. This doctrine is the foundation of human rights, of the sanctity of life, and of the command to love every neighbor.
RelatedQuestions: What does it mean to be made in the image of God?
